header.name: 3D Creation for Extended Reality (XR)
header.description: This course aims to introduce 3D modeling process required for the development of extended reality (XR/AR,VR,MR) applications. 3D modeling and its potential in various fields beyong gaming and animation will be discussed. In addition, it will focus on addressing challenges faced while using Unity (game engine) for texturing intricate objects. The creation of high-fidelity digital humans in the context of Metaverse will be introduced.
prerequisites_desirable: Knowledge of Unity and computer graphics is helpful but not mandatory.
Students will require to bring their laptops for in-class practices.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will understand the importance of 3D modeling for developing XR applications. They will get the detailed overview on the potential of 3D modeling in various fields.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to develop 3D models of realistic objects and import them to Unity

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will learn and apply different techniques of 3D scanning for reconstructing 3D obejcts/humans. They will be able to import 3D models to Unity and develop their own XR applications.

lecture_topics: Introduction to 3D creation, design and modelling theory
Types of game engine tools for building XR applications with 3D models
importance of various 3D modelling processes for a particular type of XR application
Types of 3D modeling tools and their applicability in developing XR applications
design and modeling of virtual objects
application of 3D modeling in particle systems
